newsitem.title: CANADA: DBRS confirms Falconbridge debt ratings.
newsitem.headline: DBRS confirms Falconbridge debt ratings.

text.p: Dominion Bond Rating Service said on Tuesday that it had confirmed a rating of BBB (high) on senior debentures for Falconbridge Ltd and a rating of Pfd-3 on the company's preferred shares.
DBRS also confirmed a stable trend on both ratings.

"Improving nickel prices and a recovery in zinc prices should bolster earnings for 1997, however lower cobalt prices and an uncertain outlook for copper prices are expected to limit any earnings improvement," DBRS said.
"Although debt levels will increase from current modest levels due to the high capital cost of developing Raglan and Collahuasi (mines), the balance sheet is expected to remain stable," DBRS added.
